name: PebblePad
summary: Higher education ePortfolio, workbook and assessment platform for capturing, reflecting on, curating and showcasing evidence of learning and capability.
researchTasks: Imported from the The Learning Curve assessment & credentialing dataset (research snapshot 16 Nov 2026). Evidence status: Vendor product page and official brand/media resource. University of Melbourne provides independent institutional description of PebblePad use.

AI: AI Workbook Creator is explicitly described as helping educators create workbooks. Further details on model/provider and data handling are not in the reviewed overview. Model/provider: Model/provider not disclosed in reviewed platform page. Training: Not disclosed; request confirmation on prompts, workbook content and learner data. Retention: AI interaction retention and deletion not disclosed. Subprocessors: Request AI and cloud subprocessor list. Status: AI feature disclosed; model and governance details unconfirmed.
Vendor outreach (Medium priority): Request AI model/provider, training policy, prompt retention, data residency, SOC 2/ISO, ACR, LTI/SSO/API details, export/portability and pricing.
An institutional guide exists (https://lms.unimelb.edu.au/learning-technologies/pebblepad); check whether it supports any claims.

dataGaps.note: LMS integration described as core platform capability; request exact LTI versions, grade passback, SSO and APIs.
Confirm LTI 1.3/Advantage, xAPI/portfolio export and credential interoperability where relevant.
Vendor has an accessibility section; request current ACR/VPAT and accessibility test reports.
Vendor provides a Data Security resource; request SOC 2/ISO reports, DPA, hosting and backup locations, subprocessors.
